message.reasoning:
The user says: "start Docker on window using docker start." They want to start Docker on Windows using docker start. They likely want to run a command to start Docker service. On Windows, Docker Desktop runs as a service. The command "docker start" is used to start containers, not the Docker daemon. To start Docker Desktop, you might use "Start-Service com.docker.service" or "dockerd" etc. But the user says "start Docker on window using docker start." Maybe they want to start Docker Desktop via command line. We can provide instructions: open PowerShell as admin, run "Start-Service com.docker.service" or "dockerd". Or use "docker start <container>" to start a container. But they want to start Docker itself. So we can explain that "docker start" starts containers, not the Docker engine. To start Docker Desktop, you need to start the service. Provide commands: "Start-Service com.docker.service" or "Get-Service com.docker.service | Start-Service". Or use "dockerd" if using Docker Engine. Also mention that you need to run as admin. Provide steps.

We can also use the function to execute a command. The user wants to start Docker on Windows. We can run "Start-Service com.docker.service" via PowerShell. But the function expects a Windows command line instruction. We can use "powershell -Command \"Start-Service com.docker.service\"" or "sc start com.docker.service". Let's use "sc start com.docker.service". That will start the Docker service. So we can call the function with command "sc start com.docker.service". Let's do that.
